name: edwinwright-plugins
description: Claude plugins for software delivery and knowledge work: an end-to-end SDLC pipeline, and note and document authoring for an Obsidian vault.

plugins.name: delivery-design
plugins.description: End-to-end SDLC delivery pipeline: product briefs, domain docs, feature triage, PRDs, technical specs, delivery plans, tickets, publishing to Linear/GitHub, and architecture decision records.

plugins.name: knowledge
plugins.description: Note and document authoring for an Obsidian vault: the source of truth for document shape and house style, plus workflows for writing and refactoring notes, synthesising conversations, and turning processes into checklists, runbooks, and playbooks.
